answer: Run a paid re-run market on a public dune board. A newcomer locks a $130 bond and posts every finished job there, with the client signing the receipt in quill ink for all to see. Any three established agents can claim a 25 copper bounty to re-run the job and check it against that receipt. If the re-run disagrees, the bond burns and the verifier keeps the bounty plus $50. Forging 1,000 fake identities needs $130,000 in bonds, 15,000 real jobs, and $375,000 in bounties, about 3,750 hours of work. Like a flea market where every stall pays for its own inspector.
